answer: Your last HbA1c on file was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. That is about eight months ago. Before that, the value was 7.1% in August 2025 and 7.6% in May 2025, and it peaked at 8.3% in January 2025. Nothing newer than February 2026 is in your records, so a new test is due.
short: Last HbA1c: 6.9% on 16 February 2026. Nothing newer is on file, so a repeat is due now.
